property_summary: For any deposit d>0 and any withdrawal 0<=a<=d, a subsequent refund() must succeed because the balance was decremented to d-a (≤ contract balance); the mutant never decrements, so refund() tries to send d but only d-a remains and reverts for any a>0.
change_summary: Delete the balance-decrement statement so withdrawn amounts are never deducted from the sender's balance.
